scope: Eclipse school-level content correction and unified observation/explanation navigation for 10 space topics

sources.review: Middle-school explanation of eclipse arrangements, total/partial phenomena and observation areas; source text was consulted, not reproduced.
Eclipse explanation belongs to the middle-school achievement standard. The elementary view is explicitly classified as an extension activity in content data, not a required elementary eclipse unit.

schoolScopes.elementary: Observe blocking light, shadows, and the relative positions of the Sun, Moon and Earth. No shadow subdivisions, conjunction terminology, orbit inclinations or eclipse subtype names in observation text or assessments.
schoolScopes.middle: Science 1: eclipse arrangements, total/partial types, lunar phase conditions and observation locations. Dedicated question bank without advanced shadow terminology.
schoolScopes.high: Retains detailed shadow terminology, penumbral eclipse preset, ray paths and angular-size explanations.
